notes.title: We're at the festival! Try our demo & support the project!
notes.content:
[p]Friends, this is a huge moment for us – we're finally showcasing our game demo at the festival! For months, we've eaten, slept, and breathed game dev, going through countless item iterations, endless bugs, and those rare "eureka" moments.[/p][p][/p][p]Why check it out?
• Unique genre blend – we've built something we truly believe in
• Dozens of "perfect" items – each redesigned repeatedly (yes, we write tests now!)
• Authentic demo – not just cut content, but the essence of our vision[/p][p][/p][p]We know the game isn't perfect yet. But that's the magic of indie dev – we get to shape it together with you. Your support means everything right now:[/p][p][/p][p]🌟 Wishlist it – the best way to help us grow
💬 Join our Discord – we want your ideas & feedback
📢 Tell friends – word-of-mouth is priceless for small studios[/p][p][/p][p]Links:
🎮 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607800/Backpack_Seekers/" style="button"]Play the festival demo[/url]
📌 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607800/Backpack_Seekers/" style="button"]Steam wishlist[/url]
🗣️ [url="https://discord.com/invite/backpackseekers" style="button"]Discord server[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for believing in us through all the "rake-stepping"! There's much work ahead, but with your support, we'll make it happen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45573507/92acc509d52fdbdf4d40693e11aff83be94b16ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]#IndieDev #SteamFest #GameMechanics #Roguelike[/p][p][i](P.S. What aspect interests you most? Ask us anything in the comments!)[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Backpack Seekers: A Wishlist Campaign for True Adventurers!
notes.content:
Here’s what you’ll get for joining our wishlist adventure: 
•Your name in the Hall of Fame – A permanent tribute to your support! 
•The “I Helped Make This Game Awesome” character outfit – Flex your contributor status in-game! 
•A chance to add YOUR item (Yes, even a “Magic Sausage Sandwich” – convince us and it’s in!) 
•Plus tons of other goodies (see the full list in the image below)

notes.title: BackPack Seekers — RPG × Roguelike × Backpack Management
notes.content:
You're an adventurer! The king calls for aid, taverns buzz with life, and caves hide treasures... along with hordes of monsters. Pack your bag, level up your hero, and fight—every item changes the outcome of battle!

🔥 What's inside?
✔ Deep progression + backpack optimization strategy
✔ 15 cave levels with unique enemies and loot
✔ Battle Log - analyze every fight move-by-move
✔ Taverns, shops, storage - full RPG immersion

Ready for adventure?
